$comment: Deliberate holds for scripts/check-versions.mjs. Anything newer than a hold is reported as 'held', not as an upgrade to do. Remove an entry when the reason stops applying.

node.reason: Node 24 LTS since #900 (.nvmrc); move to the next LTS on purpose, not because a newer major exists

tauriCef.reason: alpha.27 decouples the runtime; moving past alpha.26 is still undecided. macos-fps stays vendored

@types/node.reason: Types must follow the Node major we run (24)

ubuntu.reason: The Flatpak binary is built on the runner and runs on the runtime's glibc, so runner glibc must not exceed the runtime's (22.04: 2.35, 24.04: 2.39, 26.04: 2.43; runtime 24.08: 2.40, 25.08: 2.42, 26.08: 2.44). With the runtime on 26.08, 26.04 would fit too; moving the runners is a separate change
